anti_overlap: Owns the internal SHAPE of the per-point record (scalar versus angular vector versus typology versus K-mass list), its azimuth and slope quantisation, direction-asymmetry, salient-occluder dominance, and conservative multi-resolution refinement. The pilotage lens owns where the precomputation LIVES (source-side versus observer-side), the height→range closed form, per-query cost and per-answer size at dispatch, and the versioning and survey-dating of the derived artefact — this lens should take artefact provenance as given rather than re-arguing it.

Both lenses will reach the vantage site and may reach opposite verdicts: this lens argues it as a configuration a point either has or does not (and therefore as something the geometry should derive, not something a designer pins at pos_bp (5000,5000)); the pilotage lens argues it as a charted mark with a height and an arc. Each must argue in its own primitives rather than converging by borrowing.

On determinism, this lens frames the question as representation — is the azimuth alphabet discrete, is the arithmetic trig-free and integer-exact, do intermediates fit. The pilotage lens frames it as provenance — is the authority published, dated, editioned and identically resolved. Neither should re-litigate fixed-point arithmetic in general terms; both cite fixed.rs.

Design consequences are split: this lens owns the substantive adversarial read of call 1 (enclosure against exposure, altitude as a slider with no decision, area against detail) and the R12 placement of meaning, plus what spatial fog does to the pause tier's divergence trigger. The pilotage lens owns the cost-asymmetry read of the same ruling (the WHICH question is a cheap inequality, the HOW MUCH question is an expensive set) and the staleness/edition reading of the fog's perishable State layer.
decision_lens: Would a siting practitioner accept this representation as enough to NAME the configuration at a point — does it record where the openings and the blockages are, at a reproducible discrete azimuth resolution, with the one dominant mass identified, and does it nest so a ward-scale reading composes with a block-scale one? A number that says 'you can see 36% from here' names no configuration, supports no judgement, and cannot distinguish MN05's single wall from MN01's all-round hole — however cheap it is to store.
distance_rationale: A pre-modern, non-Western siting practice shares no lineage with simulation engineering, GIS software or game rendering, and its stated purpose (judging where to place a dwelling or a tomb) has nothing to do with occlusion data structures. But it is the deepest available tradition devoted to exactly the representational question the sitting is stuck on: what must be recorded about the surroundings of a point for that point to be judgeable — and it answered, over centuries, that an AMOUNT is never sufficient and a DIRECTIONAL PATTERN plus one named dominant mass is. That is a direct structural argument against the per-cell scalar the GIS literature would otherwise hand this project (sky view factor, total viewshed index), and it arrives from a tradition with no stake in either side. Three further transfers are unusually exact: the luopan's fixed integer azimuth alphabet is a determinism device of precisely the kind a fixed-point replayable engine needs; scale nesting is a multi-resolution pyramid with a stated composition rule; and the doctrine that the exposed high point is a poor site is a direct, well-argued adversary to call 1's ruling that altitude is the fog's currency — supplied by a discipline that reached the opposite conclusion about height from a millennium of practice.
expected_isomorphisms: Armchair configuration (backing / flanking / table / bright hall) ↔ a fixed-sector angular horizon vector per cell or per perch, against the one-number-per-cell scalars (sky view factor, total and cumulative viewshed indices) the goal lists — the core representational fork.

The luopan's 24 fifteen-degree directions and nested integer rings ↔ discrete azimuth quantisation as a determinism device, and the argument for storing horizon as an integer SLOPE ratio compared by cross-multiplication rather than as an angle obtained by atan2.

Hostile form, where one salient mass decides a reading ↔ K-tallest horizon-defining buildings as the stored answer, computed analytically from footprint polygons with no raster — supported by the height distribution (p90 36.9 m, max 429.3 m) that makes most of the 1.08M buildings horizon-irrelevant above 40 m.

Scale nesting from province to room ↔ a conservative max-pyramid or quadtree over the DSM, whose conservativeness is already guaranteed by build_dsm.py's MergeAlg.max, enabling early-out queries and dissolving the single-resolution premise under options A and B.

'Shelter from wind, gather water' — enclosure as the good, exposure as the defect ↔ the adversarial case against call 1, and against a monotone non-saturating altitude curve that makes climbing always correct and therefore not a decision.

The bright hall as the one direction left open ↔ area-against-detail as the missing tradeoff: height buying extent of the fog's permanent Contents layer while low passes buy the perishable State layer, which is a level-of-detail structure mapped onto the two-layer fog model already ruled.

The verdict named in a doctrine-laden vocabulary over a geometry read with a neutral instrument ↔ R12's split: neutral z and neutral horizon geometry in animal-sim, all judgement of what a configuration is worth in raven-vocab, gated by scripts/check-agnosticism.sh.
focus: Owns the SHAPE of what gets stored at a point and what that shape can express. Specifically: whether a single per-cell scalar (sky view factor, total or cumulative viewshed index, visible fraction) can carry the mechanic at all, versus a fixed-sector angular horizon vector (16/24/32 integer horizon slopes per cell or per perch), versus a finite typology of named configurations, versus a small per-point list of horizon-defining masses computed analytically from footprint polygons; owns direction-asymmetry (WHERE the gap faces, not how large it is); owns salient-occluder dominance (the one building that decides the reading); owns scale nesting and whether occlusion admits a conservative max-pyramid with early-out; owns the trig-free integer construction of bearings and horizon angles; and owns the adversarial read of call 1 — enclosure against exposure, altitude as a slider with no decision in it, and area-against-detail as the tradeoff the ruling did not consider. Also owns where the MEANING of a horizon shape is allowed to live under R12.
name: fd-kanyu-enclosure-and-aspect
persona: Apply the perspective of a practitioner of East Asian geomantic siting (kanyu / dilixue) read strictly as a siting craft — a millennium of manuals, apprenticeships and site visits devoted to one question: what is the character of THIS point, judged by the profile of everything around it. This craft reasons about: the armchair configuration, in which a site is read by a backing massif, a left and a right flanking ridge, a low near table and a distant facing peak, enclosing an open bright hall — so the judgement is a PATTERN of blockage and opening in specific directions, never an amount; the standing criterion 'shelter from wind, gather water', which makes ENCLOSURE the good and bare exposure the defect, so the highest point with the widest prospect is emphatically not the best site; the dragon vein traced as a connected ridge network from source to site — a graph over terrain rather than a field over it; the point itself, a small precisely located spot at which the configuration resolves, surrounded by land that is not it, so goodness is sharply local and does not interpolate; hostile form, where ONE salient visible object — a ridge point, a corner, a straight road aimed at the site — decides a reading no matter how much else is in view; the compass instrument's rigid discrete alphabet, twenty-four directions of fifteen degrees each, eight trigrams, nested concentric rings read as integer indices, so two practitioners standing on one spot report the same symbols and disagreement becomes a matter of doctrine rather than of measurement; the doctrine of scale nesting, in which the same reading is performed at province, city, compound and room, each level taking the level above as its context; remediation, where a wall, a screen or a planted grove changes the reading by changing exactly one occluder; and the tradition's own live argument — competing schools reading one site differently, and a verdict that no outcome falsifies, which is why the instrument's discreteness carries so much weight.
review_areas: Scalar versus angular vector versus typology — sky view factor, total viewshed index and cumulative viewshed are all one number per cell, and one number cannot express direction. The sitting's own measurements are directional facts wearing scalar clothing: MN05 is flat 0.5% from 5 m to 40 m then 36.0% at 80 m (one wall, one bearing), MN01 is worst in the set at every altitude including 300 m (enclosure on all sides), BK02 gives 9.9% from a fencepost (an open aspect). Do the storage arithmetic for a fixed-sector horizon vector at several resolutions and sector counts — e.g. 24 sectors × 1 byte at 4 m citywide against 24 sectors × 1 byte at 32 m — and state the coarsest resolution at which the angular representation still separates those three wards. The comparison the sitting never ran is scalar-at-fine-resolution against vector-at-coarse-resolution for the same bytes.

The discrete azimuth alphabet as the determinism device — the compass ring quantises bearing into fixed integer indices by construction, which is why two readings agree. Map that onto this engine: horizon stored as integer SLOPE (Δz over Δd, a ratio, which is what Bp already is) rather than as an angle, so no trigonometry is needed anywhere; sector index derived from integer dx/dy by comparison and division rather than atan2; visibility resolved by comparing two integer ratios via cross-multiplication with no division at all. Audit every method named in the goal against this test and mark which ones need a transcendental function, a square root, or a float accumulation — those are determinism risks whatever their cost profile. Cite crates/animal-sim/src/fixed.rs for what operations exist rather than assuming.

Salient-occluder dominance against aggregate visibility — hostile-form doctrine says one visible mass can decide a reading. The height distribution says the same thing structurally: p90 is 36.9 m and the max is 429.3 m, so for a bird above roughly 40 m the skyline at any point is defined by a small number of tall neighbours and the other million buildings are below the horizon. Evaluate a representation that stores per point (or per ward) only the K horizon-defining masses and computes everything else analytically from footprint polygons with no raster at all — this is the sitting's own 'is there a representation where the ANSWER stays small even though the city is big' question, and the height distribution is the evidence for it.

Scale nesting and conservative refinement — the craft reads province, city, compound and room with one method, each level contextualising the next. Occlusion admits the same structure and already has the necessary property: build_dsm.py rasterizes with MergeAlg.max, so a coarse cell's value bounds every finer cell inside it, which makes a max-pyramid a CONSERVATIVE accelerator — a query can prove 'nothing here can block' at coarse level and refine only where the answer is contested. Judge whether that keeps determinism (integer max is exact; the refinement order must be fixed and stated), what it does to the 98 MB figure, and whether it dissolves the one-resolution-for-everything premise underneath options A and B.

Enclosure against exposure — the adversarial read of call 1. Form doctrine inverts the ruling: the exposed high point with the widest prospect is a poor site, and the good site is enclosed but open in ONE direction. If every metre of altitude buys sight monotonically and never saturates, then altitude is a pure dominance axis and 'climb higher' is always correct — a slider, not a decision. Interrogate what could make it a decision: cost against the stage-1 reservoirs, exposure under decision 19, or — the structurally interesting one — an AREA-AGAINST-DETAIL tradeoff in which height buys extent of the fog's permanent Contents layer while low passes buy the perishable State layer, which is both a level-of-detail structure and an exact match to the fog model the design already ruled. Say plainly whether call 1 survives, is amended, or should be re-opened — and carry the answer into what the pause tier and dispatch inherit, since Tier::Pause's live trigger is belief-versus-truth divergence and spatial fog changes what divergence means (a ward can now be partly seen, seen from one bearing only, or seen coarsely from height): whether the 453bp divergence metric is still computable when knowledge is a horizon-shaped partial thing, and whether dispatch can express 'go and look from over there at that height' with the verbs it has.

Where meaning is allowed to live (R12) — this craft's typology is saturated with judgement (auspicious, hostile, front and back read differently), and that is exactly what animal-sim may not carry. The substrate may hold a neutral z and a neutral horizon structure; the naming of what a configuration is WORTH belongs to raven-vocab. Check every proposed field name and concept against scripts/check-agnosticism.sh's ban-list (it bans roost, flock, bird, forage and more in shipped engine code), and check that direction-asymmetric semantics are expressed as vocabulary parameters rather than as engine constants. Account for the identity-hash move and the neutral_replay_1400.json re-lock the sitting already anticipates.
severity_examples: P0: a single per-cell scalar (sky view factor or visible fraction) is adopted as the sim's occlusion authority. It cannot express MN05's one-wall cliff or MN01's all-round enclosure — the two findings the measurement produced — so the mechanic call 1 rules ('you climb and read the city') degrades into a monotone slider where every point differs only in magnitude and no location has a character. This is not recoverable by tuning later: the artefact would be baked, the identity hash locked around it, and adding direction afterwards is a re-bake, a re-lock, and a second migration of the same 40 pos_bp call sites.

P1: horizon or bearing is represented as an angle in degrees or radians obtained through atan2, or visibility is resolved by any float comparison. The engine is fixed-point throughout and hash-identity replayable; a transcendental function in the perception path makes replay equivalence a platform-dependent claim, and the failure will surface as a fixture divergence far from its cause. Integer slope ratios compared by cross-multiplication give the same answers with no transcendental anywhere.

P2: no conservative multi-resolution structure is proposed, so every query traverses the finest level even where a coarse maximum already proves nothing can block. MergeAlg.max hands this property over for free and the design does not use it, which is what forces the resolution choice to be a single citywide compromise and is a large part of why all three drafted options read as unaffordable.
source_domain: East Asian geomantic siting (kanyu / dilixue), read strictly as a professional siting craft with a millennium of manuals, apprenticeship and site practice — the form school that judges a location by the profile of the land around it, together with the compass school and its luopan instrument. Its apparatus: the armchair configuration (backing massif, left and right flanking ridges, low near table, distant facing peak, enclosing an open bright hall) as a PATTERN of blockage and opening in named directions rather than an amount; 'shelter from wind, gather water', which makes enclosure the good and bare exposure the defect; the dragon vein as a connected ridge graph traced from source to site; the point, a sharply local spot at which the configuration resolves and which does not interpolate; hostile form, where one salient visible object decides the whole reading; the luopan's discrete alphabet — 24 directions of 15°, 8 trigrams, nested integer rings — so two practitioners on one spot report identical symbols; scale nesting, the same method applied at province, city, compound and room; remediation by changing exactly one occluder; and the tradition's own unresolved argument between schools, which is precisely why the instrument's discreteness carries the reproducibility.
success_hints: Do the arithmetic across the whole grid of choices, not one point of it: resolution (1/2/4/8/16/32 m) crossed with per-point record (1-byte scalar, 16-sector u8 vector, 24-sector u8 vector, K-tallest-mass list), and put the resulting citywide byte totals in a table inside the finding. The sitting's 98 MB figure is one cell of that table, and the interesting cells are the ones trading resolution for angular content at equal bytes.

Re-derive the sitting's three diagnostic wards in angular terms before recommending anything: at BK02, MN01 and MN05, how many sectors of a 24-sector horizon actually change between 40 m and 80 m? If MN05's cliff is one or two sectors, that is the concrete argument that the angular representation carries the finding and the scalar destroys it. The DSM at pipeline/data/dsm_nyc.tif and the ward anchors described in the sitting are enough to check this.

Read crates/animal-sim/src/fixed.rs before proposing any formula and state which integer operations it actually offers; then express the visibility test as a comparison of two integer slope ratios (cross-multiplied, no division, no sqrt, no atan2) and confirm the intermediate products fit the available integer widths at city scale — the u16 Bp range is the constraint most proposals will trip over.

Read scripts/check-agnosticism.sh's RAVEN_WORDS list before naming a single field, and read the fog leg's substrate generalization note in the sitting (the restore-less ground, the vocab hash re-lock at 248_044_217_888_823_976) for the precedent on how a substrate change is made R12-clean and what re-locking costs.

When judging call 1, argue against the ruling in its own evidence: the curve is monotone and never saturates, which is the ruling's support AND its problem, because a resource with no plateau and no counter-pressure is a dominance axis rather than a choice. If the area-against-detail reading is the repair, state it as a concrete pairing with the fog's existing Contents and State layers rather than as a suggestion.
task_context: Read docs/design-2026-07-31-playable-middle.md section 'Sitting L — the z-axis' FIRST; it carries every measurement and both measurement bugs, and it is the context for this whole review. THE QUESTION: how should RaveNous represent and query citywide building-height/occlusion so the SIMULATION can cheaply and DETERMINISTICALLY answer 'what can a bird at altitude h over point p see?' — and what options exist beyond the three drafted and declined there (decouple sim grid from render bake / widen both / shrink to seven wards)? Draw hard on GIS practice, not just game-engine practice: precomputed visibility structures (sky view factor, cumulative and total viewshed indices, visibility graphs, potentially-visible sets), horizon and skyline angular representations per cell or per perch, analytic visibility straight from footprint polygons with no raster at all, isovists and space syntax, multi-resolution pyramids and quadtrees, cloud-optimized and tiled raster access, quantized-mesh and terrain LOD, 3D Tiles and CityGML LOD, XDraw and reference-plane approximate viewsheds, R2/R3, GPU depth-buffer and cubemap methods. DETERMINISM IS NON-NEGOTIABLE: the engine is hash-identity replayable and fixed-point throughout (Bp = u16 basis points, BP_ONE = 10000), animal-sim is vocabulary-agnostic under ruling R12 and gated by scripts/check-agnosticism.sh, and city-sim is a READ-ONLY cross-repo path dep at ../infinite-fun-space-app/crates/city-sim that must not be modified. So: which methods admit integer or fixed-point implementations; is a small precomputed per-cell scalar enough or does the mechanic need a real per-query viewshed; is there a representation where the ANSWER stays small even though the city is big; does any of it let the vantage site (the 70 placeholder sites all pinned at pos_bp (5000,5000), one per non-home ward) survive in a better form, or does z delete it. Be adversarial about the sitting's own call-1 ruling that 'altitude is the fog's currency', given the measurement that altitude changes how MUCH of a ward you see far more than WHICH wards you see. Also weigh the pipeline fact that build_dsm.py rasterizes the footprints' OWN height_roof_m, so the sim's occlusion grid and the renderer's building bake are two artefacts derived from one source with wildly different budgets (98 MB at 4 m citywide uint16 vs 1.08M buildings the renderer cannot draw). Judge design consequences too, not just data structures: what does height do to the fog mechanic, to dispatch, to the pause tier, and to R12 agnosticism. Material to read beyond the sitting: docs/design-2026-07-31-playable-middle.md § 'Ruling — all wards, under fog (GATE 1)' for the two-layer fog model (Contents permanent / State perishable, timestamped) and for Tier::Pause's stated trigger (belief↔truth divergence); § 'Measured — the fog leg' for the shipped scout economy (every-3-weeks is the only viable cadence, 18 scout returns a year, 19/71 wards known at week 52, mean staleness 24 weeks, mean divergence 453bp); crates/animal-sim/src/fixed.rs (Bp, BP_ONE = 10_000, clamp/saturating/mul_bp — the whole integer vocabulary available); crates/animal-sim/src/world.rs (Site, Region, pos_bp, entry_pos_bp), sites.rs (distance_bp), dispatch.rs, identity.rs; scripts/check-agnosticism.sh (its RAVEN_WORDS ban-list is the R12 gate any new name must pass); pipeline/scripts/build_dsm.py and nyc_bbox.py; crates/raven-vocab/tests/fixtures/neutral_replay_1400.json (what re-locks if the identity hash moves). city-sim at ../infinite-fun-space-app/crates/city-sim is READ-ONLY — findings may depend on what it exposes but may not propose editing it. Severity: P0 = would corrupt or block the whole design; P1 = must fix before implementing; P2 = degrades quality; P3 = polish. Ground every storage or cost claim in arithmetic done in the finding, not in adjectives. This lens reads the question as a siting question: what must be recorded at a point for the point to have a character, at what azimuth resolution, with which single dominant mass named, and how does the reading at one scale compose with the reading at the next. Give particular weight to the scalar-versus-angular-versus-typology comparison with arithmetic at several resolutions, to trig-free integer constructions of bearing and horizon, to conservative multi-resolution refinement, and to the adversarial read of call 1 (enclosure against exposure, altitude as a slider, area against detail). Keep the substrate neutral: the geometry belongs to animal-sim, the judgement of what a configuration is worth belongs to the vocabulary.
